framework: AICPA SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022 points of focus)
disclaimer: DefenTail produces technical evidence only. SOC 2 is an attestation performed by a licensed CPA firm against a defined system description; this file is not an audit opinion, not a certification, and does not cover organizational, HR, vendor, or governance controls.

criteria.title: Information quality used in the system
criteria.simple: The records you rely on should be accurate, complete and available when needed.
defentail_evidence: Timestamped scan reports with a SHA-256 integrity digest
Append-only memory ledger of scans and release decisions
human_evidence: Data quality and review procedures
Evidence that reports were actually reviewed before release

criteria.title: Risk identification and analysis
criteria.simple: You should know what could go wrong and how likely it is.
defentail_evidence: Curated lessons from verified incidents mapped to checks
Recurring-finding history showing where problems concentrate
human_evidence: Documented risk assessment and risk register
Management review and acceptance of residual risk

criteria.title: Monitoring activities
criteria.simple: Someone should be watching for problems on a schedule, not once.
defentail_evidence: Per-run coverage record of which checks ran and which did not
Memory ledger with first-seen, last-seen and recurrence per finding
human_evidence: Monitoring schedule and ownership
Escalation and remediation records

criteria.title: Logical access and credential protection
criteria.simple: Only the right people should get in, and keys must not lie around in code.
defentail_evidence: Secret and private-key exposure findings with values redacted
Confirmation of whether a secret scanner actually ran
human_evidence: Access reviews for production systems
Key rotation records and secret-manager configuration
Authorization tests for every protected route

criteria.title: Protection of data in transmission
criteria.simple: Data travelling over the network must be encrypted and verified.
defentail_evidence: Detection of disabled TLS certificate verification in application code
Configuration findings reported by an installed configuration scanner
human_evidence: TLS configuration review for each deployed endpoint
Certificate lifecycle and renewal records

criteria.title: Detection of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations
criteria.simple: Known weak spots in your code and building blocks should be found before attackers do.
defentail_evidence: Static analysis, dependency-advisory and secret scan results
Which engines were unavailable, reported instead of silently passed
Known-exploited-vulnerability enrichment when the CISA feed is present
human_evidence: Vulnerability management policy and remediation SLAs
Penetration test or independent assessment reports

criteria.title: Monitoring for anomalies
criteria.simple: Unusual activity should be noticed while it is happening.
defentail_evidence: Change-time scanning through the watcher or agent guard
New-finding comparison between two points in time
human_evidence: Runtime logging, alerting and on-call procedures
Incident response records

criteria.title: Change management
criteria.simple: Changes should be reviewed, tested and approved before they reach users.
defentail_evidence: Before/after comparison of findings across a change
Guard verdicts recorded per change in the memory ledger
Explicit blockers instead of an unqualified pass
human_evidence: Code review and approval records
Test results and deployment authorization
Segregation of duties for production changes

criteria.title: Availability and recovery
criteria.simple: The service should keep working and recover if something breaks.
human_evidence: Capacity monitoring and backup verification
Disaster recovery tests and restore evidence

criteria.title: Privacy notice and consent
criteria.simple: People should be told what you collect and agree to it.
human_evidence: Published privacy notice and consent flows
Data subject request handling records
Data inventory and retention schedule
